title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation

translated_title: AVC-Reward：以事件为中心的音视频一致性评估
translated_abstract: 随着联合音视频生成模型的能力不断提升，它们能够生成展现三种复杂形式的视听场景：多事件组合、多层音频混合以及非对称的跨模态关系。然而，当前的评估方法大多沿用了早期简单且单向任务的指标。这些方法通常将音视频片段作为一个整体进行评估，并依赖简单的预定义关系，因而难以适用于日益复杂的场景。我们提出了一种以事件为中心的评估框架，该框架在事件层面解耦音频与视觉事件，独立分析每个事件，跨模态交叉验证事件间的关系，并将各项判断聚合为一个由粗到细的三级一致性指标。该指标可评估全局叙事协调性、事件级时间同步性以及细粒度属性对齐，为音视频一致性评估提供了一种通用范式。
tldr: 提出一种以事件为中心的音视频一致性评估框架，通过解耦事件、跨模态交叉验证并聚合为三级由粗到细的指标，实现对复杂音视频场景的全局叙事协调性、事件级时间同步性和细粒度属性对齐的综合评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes an event-centric audio-video consistency evaluation framework that disentangles events, cross-validates cross-modal relations, and aggregates them into a coarse-to-fine three-level metric, enabling comprehensive assessment of global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment in complex audio-visual scenes.
